title: BRIDGE UPDATE -  cNFTcon + Rare Bloom Recap | Cornucopias
description:
Chainport bridge coming VERY SOON, Photos from cNFTcon + Rare Bloom and the Cardano Summit Voting is open.

Josh & Rob kick off this COPI Cafe by discussing the much anticipated Chainport Bridge and when the community can expect an LIVE DATE announcement. Along with sharing some photos from cNFTcon and Rare Bloom they also discuss the reaction of the community members seeing the demos in person. The guys also cover the upcoming 2022 Cardano Summit and encourage everyone to go vote (we are listed in the gaming and metaverse categories). They wrap up the episode discussing the NEWM partnership.

PLEASE GO VOTE FOR YOUR FAVORITE FOUNDERS TO APPEAR AT THE 2022 CARDANO SUMMIT: https://voting.summit.cardano.org/categories

00:00 - Intro
00:20 - Getting Back to Work After the Conferences
01:58 - Beverage Choices
04:00 - Chainport Bridge Update
06:45 - Art from cNFTcon
08:59 - COPI Stake Pool Update
10:16 - Photos/Recap of cNFTcon
20:28 - Photos/Recap of Rare Bloom
28:22 - 2022 Cardano Summit Vote
31:40 - IS THIS REAL?
33:13 - Upcoming weeks of Planning
33:40 - NEWM Partnership

Post your contest entries for this episode into the "Word Game" channel in Discord. 

Other MUST-SEE videos: 
PVP Gameplay: https://youtu.be/Gtw3qAgaXYI 
Custom Dome Tour: https://youtu.be/aL_4dTFKyJk 
Solace Teaser: https://youtu.be/v52pdDdPzMw


#Metaverse #Cardano #CryptoCurrency #Blockchain #NFT #MetaverseGame #IOHK

https://linktr.ee/cornucopias.game
